violations.text: No plan review submitted and approved - renovations were made or are in progress. The direct link to the Plan Review page is https://www2.myfloridalicense.com/hotels-restaurants/licensing/plan-review/. Operator has added a household stove/oven, handwashing sink, and household refrigerator to the front hall way near restrooms. Update plans and submit to DBPR plan review.
